bio: Run by the Anderhalden family, this remotely located establishment is a delightful spot. Dine in the restaurant-cum-parlour – the lounge area with its fireplace is ideal for an aperitif – or the cosy Stübli with its beautiful wooden floor and elegant table settings. The chef-patron serves up flavoursome Swiss cuisine, drawing on fresh seasonal produce and international influences. The menu ranges from beef fillet stroganoff to Mediterranean-inspired pasta dishes and Indian lamb curry. Service comes courtesy of the attentive proprietress, who is always on hand....
